name: Ho Chih-chang
bio: Ho Chih-chang, born in AD 659, was a T’ang official and poet, and an early admirer and friend of Li Po. His poem here is a homecoming after long absence.
The poems here are Herbert A. Giles’s versions in Chinese Poetry in English Verse (1898), given with the poet’s name as spelled in that book.

poems.title: The Return
poems.author: Ho Chih-chang
poems.text:
Bowed down with age I seek my native place,
Unchanged my speech, my hair is silvered now;
My very children do not know my face,
But smiling ask, "O stranger, whence art thou?"

poems.title: Coming Home
poems.author: Ho Chih-chang
poems.translator: trans. Witter Bynner and Kiang Kang-hu (1929)
poems.text:
I left home young. I return old,
Speaking as then, but with hair grown thin;
And my children, meeting me, do not know me.
They smile and say: “Stranger, where do you come from?”

poems.title: 題袁氏別業 (Ti yuan shi bie ye)
poems.author: Ho Chih-chang
poems.collection: 千家詩 (Poems of a Thousand Poets)
poems.text:
主人不相識，偶坐爲林泉。
莫謾愁沽酒，囊中自有錢。

poems.title: 回鄉偶書二首·其一 (Hui xiang ou shu er shou, qi yi)
poems.author: Ho Chih-chang
poems.collection: 唐詩三百首 (Three Hundred Tang Poems)
poems.text:
少小離家老大回，鄉音無改鬢毛衰。
兒童相見不相識，笑問客從何處來。

poems.title: 詠柳 (Yong liu)
poems.author: Ho Chih-chang
poems.text:
碧玉妝成一樹高，萬條垂下綠絲縧。
不知細葉誰裁出，二月春風似剪刀。

poems.title: 回鄉偶書二首·其二 (Hui xiang ou shu er shou, qi er)
poems.author: Ho Chih-chang
poems.text:
離別家鄉歲月多，近來人事半銷磨。
唯有門前鏡湖水，春風不改舊時波。
